guard_streams.write_limit: Connected Nations 2024 is an annual aggregate infrastructure report. It cannot establish current selected-parcel orderability, exact corrected Spring 2026 r2 coverage or parcel-measured speed.

facts.detail: Ofcom published Connected Nations 2024 on 5 December 2024.
The page records a last update on 11 November 2025.
The report covers coverage and usage of fixed broadband and mobile networks in the UK.
It includes take-up of services on full-fibre networks.
It includes take-up of services on gigabit-capable networks.
It reports further development of 4G networks.
It reports progress in the rollout of 5G networks.
Separate reports were published for each UK nation.
An interactive report provides views for different areas and services.
The publication links a UK report, methodology annex and data downloads.

guard_streams.write_limit: File catalogues and historic 2024 ZIPs require exact file, schema, snapshot and parcel-identity validation. They cannot be promoted as current Spring 2026 parcel coverage.

facts.detail: Ofcom published the 2024 data-download page on 5 December 2024.
The page was last updated on 28 March 2025.
Ofcom says the downloads support year-on-year infrastructure comparisons.
The catalogue lists a fixed-coverage UK and nations ZIP of 164 KB.
It lists fixed-coverage output-area data as a 9.3 MB ZIP.
It lists fixed-coverage postcode data as a 32.6 MB ZIP.
It includes fixed-performance data for local authorities and Westminster constituencies.
It lists fixed-performance output-area data as a 3.59 MB ZIP.
It lists mobile-coverage UK and nations data as a 246 KB ZIP.
The page directs data questions and feedback to Ofcom's Connected Nations data team.
